description:
SeniorPulse: Global elder care intelligence API. AI-synthesized Medicare guidance, care facility evaluation, medication safety, benefits discovery, and caregiver support for seniors and their families worldwide. U

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • medicare ($0.15): Medicare plan guidance (or country-equivalent senior health coverage)
  • facility ($0.15): Care facility evaluation guide
  • meds ($0.10): Medication safety check for elderly patients (polypharmacy)
  • benefits ($0.10): Benefits eligibility assessment (US by default; country-aware)
  • caregiver ($0.10): Family caregiver resource guide
  • grief ($0.10): Post-loss estate and grief guide
  • legal ($0.10): Elder law document guide (POA, advance directive, guardianship)
  • memory ($0.10): Cognitive decline staging and dementia care trajectory
  • nh-compare ($0.15): Nursing home / care home quality comparison (CMS Care Compare by default; country-aware)
  • property-tax ($0.08): Senior property tax relief programs by state (US by default; country-aware)
  • rx-assist ($0.10): Prescription assistance programs (Extra Help, state programs, pharma PAPs; country-aware)
  • snap-utility ($0.10): Senior SNAP food assistance and LIHEAP utility assistance (US by default; country-aware)
  • veterans ($0.15): VA Aid & Attendance and senior veteran benefits (US by default; country-aware)
  • pension-intl ($0.15): International state/public pension intelligence

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: medicare | facility | meds | benefits | caregiver | grief | legal | memory | nh-compare | property-tax | rx-assist | snap-utility | veterans | pension-intl

age.description: Patient age — used to calibrate Beers Criteria thresholds (most critical for ages 65–75 vs. 85+)

assets.description: Total countable assets in USD — excludes primary home and one vehicle

budget.description: Monthly budget in local currency (USD for US, GBP for UK, AUD for Australia, CAD for Canada)

capacity_concern.description: Set true if there are concerns about the senior's cognitive capacity to sign legal documents — triggers guardianship guidance

care_cost.description: Monthly unreimbursed care costs in USD (home health aide, assisted living, adult day care)

country.description: Country of residence — defaults to US Medicare if omitted. Set for non-US countries (e.g. 'United Kingdom', 'Canada', 'Germany') to get that country's senior health coverage instead.

current_living.description: Current living situation (e.g. 'alone', 'with spouse', 'with adult children', 'assisted living')

days_since.description: Days since the loss — calibrates guidance to immediate (0–7 days), short-term (1–4 weeks), or ongoing estate (1–12 months) phases

diagnosis.description: Formal diagnosis if known (e.g. 'Alzheimer's', 'vascular dementia', 'Lewy body', 'MCI', 'frontotemporal')

facilities.description: Comma-separated facility names or addresses to compare head-to-head (e.g. 'Sunrise Senior Living Austin,Brookdale South Austin')

has_poa.description: Whether an existing POA is in place — affects urgency and next steps

home_value.description: Estimated home value in USD — used to estimate annual savings

household_size.description: Number of people in the household — SNAP limits vary by household size

income.description: Monthly gross income in USD (Social Security, pension, wages)

lang.description: Response language (e.g. 'es', 'zh', 'ko', 'vi', 'tl') — Claude responds natively in any language

location.description: City and state/country (e.g. 'Austin TX', 'London UK', 'Toronto Canada', 'Sydney Australia')

medical_expenses.description: Monthly out-of-pocket medical expenses — seniors can deduct excess medical costs to qualify for SNAP

medications.description: Comma-separated medication list using generic names (e.g. 'metformin,lisinopril,aspirin,diphenhydramine,amlodipine')

mmse_score.description: Mini-Mental State Examination score (0–30). 24–30 normal, 18–23 mild, 0–17 severe.

moca_score.description: Montreal Cognitive Assessment score (0–30). Below 26 indicates possible impairment.

moved_abroad_to.description: Country the person has moved or plans to move to, if different from the pension-paying country — triggers cross-border/totalization analysis

on_medicare.description: Whether the senior is enrolled in Medicare Part D — affects Extra Help vs. manufacturer PAP eligibility

own_home.description: Whether the senior owns their home — affects LIHEAP eligibility and some SNAP asset tests

situation.description: Enrollment scenario — e.g. 'turning 65', 'comparing plans', 'losing employer coverage at 67', 'enrolling due to disability', 'reviewing Part D'

surviving_spouse.description: Set true if the applicant is a surviving spouse of a veteran — unlocks Survivors Pension and Aid & Attendance for surviving spouses

topic.description: Focus area. Defaults to a full overview covering all four.

veteran.description: Set true to include VA Aid & Attendance and other veteran-specific benefits in the assessment

years_contributed.description: Years of contributions or residency toward the pension so far, if known

zip.description: ZIP code for plan availability context (US)

name: seniorpulse
